rollover.identity: Tenant / program-rollovers / RolloverId, with exact source program/version and successor proof. RolloverId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId.
rollover.invariant: One exact carry-forward proposal version needs independent approved decision before recording exact successor period/plan identities; completed source provenance remains immutable.
rollover.rationale: Proposal/current approval and execution claim must coordinate to prevent approved version changing while successor is created. Prior proposal history is unnecessary state; successor creation acknowledgement belongs to recoverable process storage.

plan.identity: Tenant / type-ii-plans / PlanId, with immutable ProgramId. PlanId identifies creation; selected mutations use CommandId with exact plan version/source/decision bindings.
plan.invariant: Only current proposed content with exact carried-gap acknowledgements receives an independent review; executive approval requires review and three distinct roles, after which plan is immutable.
plan.rationale: Current authored content/reviewer/approver must remain one same-version decision. Past proposal bodies/reviews are historical records and need not remain state.

period.identity: Tenant / type-ii-periods / PeriodId, with immutable ProgramId and exact accepted plan/opening. PeriodId identifies creation; selected CommandId/GenerationKey identify exact freeze/reconciliation/amendment operations and their immutable closing identities.
period.invariant: One period binds exact approved opening plan/population; close must reconcile the approved expected population, independently acknowledge all unresolved material items, and freeze the same approved sources. Close amendments preserve original expected population/acknowledgements and chain exact changed sources.
period.rationale: The immutable approved expected-population manifest is a legitimate value proof for close, not a live roster of occurrence children. Keep a narrow period close/lineage owner; move occurrence-generation process/batches and immutable close snapshots/history out of active state. Preserve canonical frozen manifest and current closure lineage digest so atomic close rules remain exact.

relevantRules: Rollover proposal freezes exact source closed period/outcome, carry-forward choices, NextPeriodId, NextTypeIIPlanId, and dates. It is independently approved by version; revisions remain possible before period_created.

TypeII plan proposal is an independent owner. It requires exact source review; an exact plan version requires independent review and separate executive approval (different actors), and can be revised.

StartTypeIIObservationPeriod only accepts exact current approved TypeIIPlan version and source tuple, then emits TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted. Existing TypeIIRangeProcess acquires range, applies opening, and settles; actual started fact is later than accepted admission.

Current rollover event ProgramNextPeriodCreated is emitted by ProgramRollover after checking exact successor IDs but catalog boundary rationale says successor creation acknowledgement belongs in recoverable private process storage.

fence.instructions: Which execution fence is required before any successor owner is mutated?

criteria.aggregate_claim: A single atomic ProgramRollover command claims the exact approved version and prevents revision/rejection after claim; then a durable private process executes.
criteria.private_claim_only: A process-store CAS on its own is sufficient; aggregate revision can remain independently permitted.
criteria.read_then_write: Read approved revision, then issue target commands; stale revision can be detected at terminal receipt.
criteria.insufficient: The facts do not establish the race.

terminal.instructions: What event constitutes successful completion of this rollover process?

criteria.period_started: Wait for actual ObservationPeriodStarted for the exact pinned period, plan and approved version, plus verified plan approval/review proofs; only then report operational completion.
criteria.opening_accepted: TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted for the exact plan and period is sufficient; report accepted/pending while existing TypeIIRangeProcess continues independently.
criteria.plan_approved: Approved TypeIIPlan is sufficient; period creation may proceed later.
criteria.insufficient: No selected completion state is supported.

plan_boundary.instructions: May rollover process directly create an approved TypeIIPlan in one step?

criteria.must_preserve_independent_plan_governanc: No. It may submit the exact frozen plan proposal to the TypeIIPlan owner, but that owner must receive its required independent plan review and separate executive approval before period start.
criteria.rollover_approval_covers_plan: Yes. Independent rollover approval can substitute for TypeIIPlan owner review and approval.
criteria.not_enough_info: The plan owner rules are not supplied.

rows.instructions: Does the current selected catalog define all rollover execution commands, events, process stages, source proofs and recovery outcomes?

criteria.true: The selected rows identify the atomic version fence, target owner commands, actual approval/period proofs, terminal rule, and restart/idempotency/abort behavior.
criteria.false: At least one of these decision-critical parts is absent.

event.instructions: Where should the terminal successor acknowledgement live?

criteria.process_record: Private process record stores the exact verified plan and period terminal fact references; ProgramRollover remains proposal/approval plus one atomic execution claim/fence and does not emit ProgramNextPeriodCreated.
criteria.rollover_event: ProgramRollover emits ProgramNextPeriodCreated after the process receives exact target proofs.
criteria.both: Keep both a private process terminal and aggregate acknowledgement event.
criteria.insufficient: The appropriate authority boundary is unclear.
